notes.title: 🛠️ Owl Force Demo Hotfix 2 – Changelog 🛠️
notes.notes:
🛠️ Owl Force Demo Hotfix – Changelog 🛠️

Fixed:

NPC population now spawns correctly around the Celestial Nebula
Cargo option removed from the level-up menu (feature not yet implemented)
Progression bug fixed, allowing access to the Fortress quest
Multiple quality-of-life improvements
⚠️ Note: Progress will be reset the next time you load the game. Thanks for your understanding, and we appreciate your continued support! 🦉

Keep the feedback coming, and see you in the skies!

notes.title: Owl Force Free Demo
notes.notes:
The wait is over! The Owl Force demo is officially live and kicking as part of Steam Next Fest. This action-packed prequel sets the stage for the full adventure coming soon – so make sure to check it out and explore the story that starts it all.

[list]
[*] Known Bug Alert: During the first mission, enemies may spawn infinitely – but don’t worry! Just find and rescue Zara to get things back on track.
[/list]

I’m humbled by the overwhelming support so far – it’s been amazing to see so many of you already diving in and having fun!

Pro Tip: Keep an eye out for dynamic missions marked with the red skull symbol – but beware! Difficulty levels (shown by red diamonds) can give even the best pilots a serious challenge.

While you’re enjoying the demo, be sure to explore all the other incredible games featured during Steam Next Fest. If you’re loving Owl Force, please remember to wishlist it – it really helps!

Thank you so much for your support. Now get out there and show the Darktail Order what you’re made of! 🦉

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/477850/Owl_Force/]🔗 Play now, explore, and wishlist on Steam![/url]
